source_text: Claims minimizing FGM/C as voluntary cultural choice lack empirical support, as procedures target non-consenting minors—often infants or young girls—causing immediate risks like hemorrhage and infection alongside long-term complications such as urinary issues, sexual dysfunction, and psychological trauma, corroborated by clinical outcomes in affected communities.
